purpose: Make already-merged failure-learning functions the explicit entrypoint for approved file operations and produce failure drafts automatically after observed failures, without implying all clients are intercepted.
preserve: main and cb6-v2-clean except separately approved PR merge
PR #13 and its approved signal changes

execution_contract.prewrite: For an owner-approved file write, obtain authenticated GitHub user, PR, branch, main, ruleset and comment evidence; call existing operation_bridge.apply_approved_write on exact approved candidate bytes, fail closed on mismatch.
execution_contract.after_failure: Capture exact failure code, operation, HEAD and evidence into a local pending JSON record; call existing recurrence logic only when record validates; label unverified root cause/prevention as pending review, never fabricate PASS or confirmed diagnosis.
execution_contract.persistence: Save only a local draft in this phase; no automatic change to protected GitHub failure ledger. A later owner-approved PR is required to make a ledger record authoritative.
execution_contract.out_of_scope: No interception of direct GitHub plugin writes, no automatic workflow trigger, no Ruleset edits, no automated issue comment, no direct main update, no merge or Release.

new_scope_tests_only: Mismatched actor, PR head, main, scope, approval evidence, Ruleset and draft digest BLOCK before write
Approved draft calls the existing bridge once; duplicate attempts and unknown outcomes require reconciliation
A failed write generates a local evidence draft without writing GitHub ledger
Same known cause_key is classified for recurrence review, not silently adopted
Missing evidence and unsupported failure shape never auto-publish
Existing code files and already-PASS test suites remain unmodified and unrerun
authorization_sequence: Owner explicitly approves narrowly scoped new PR plan
Commit canonical plan before PR creation
Record owner-authored unedited GitHub approval bound to plan commit and SHA before PR creation
Add only the two new implementation files; create one PR
Require existing trusted Required Check and separate-GPT delta-only review
Merge only on a second owner approval
limitations: The GitHub connector and other unmodified clients can bypass the opt-in runner
No automatic authoritative ledger persistence to GitHub
The GitHub Contents API does not atomically compare-and-swap branch HEAD
Existing limited shell parser is not a full Bash/YAML parser
